steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: It's me. The spokesman incident is over——
......Platinum.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...Who are you? I'm looking for the director...
Doesn't matter. You should have received the authorization code for this terminal.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Since you know about this channel, you aren't one of the two Lazurites. So...
Just keep your suspicions to yourself and refrain from looking too hard.
What I am saying next will be between the 'Armorless Union', and nothing to do with the 'directors'.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ......Alright.
A squad of campaign knights crossed into the Twilight Wood in secret. This went unnoticed by the General Chamber of Commerce, so it likely has something to do with the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Silverlance...?
The Lazurite will take full responsibility for this matter, don't trouble yourself.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Haah? Since when are they so responsible?
Your mission is to monitor the Radiant Knight in their stead.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The Radiant Knight... that's a pain.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ——So they've got an even bigger pain over there?
Still unclear. The ripples from a single stone spread far. The return of the Radiant Knight has brought us a lot of trouble... In fact, we're devoting too much of our attention on her.
...One more thing.
No matter what, do not take action against the Sarkaz with the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Those two Sarkaz... You seem to know a lot about them.
The Confessarius and the Radiant Knight also belong to another 'company.' Will this matter be so simple...? I'm not sure.
Just handle your own tasks properly and don't mess up like before.
We'll be busier.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Ahh... It's the phone again... Are they looking for Mr. Czarny?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: But Mr. Czarny... has been gone for a while.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: ...Hello?

steps.name: Deep Male Voice
steps.text: The spokesman?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Ah, no. Sorry, Mr. Czarny is currently——

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Wh-what?

steps.name: Deep Male Voice
steps.text: I dialed the spokesman's number, and you answered.

steps.name: Deep Male Voice
steps.text: Therefore, you are the spokesman.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Huh? Wh-what? I don't understand——

steps.name: Deep Male Voice
steps.text: Name.

steps.name: Deep Male Voice
steps.text: Name.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Err, please call me Malkiewicz. I used to work for Słoma Food Company, until Mr. Czarny invited me to work with him...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: S-Sir? Is Mr. Czarny——?

steps.name: Bold Female Voice
steps.text: Good day, Mr. Malkiewicz.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Ah, sorry, Miss. I thought that——

steps.name: Bold Female Voice
steps.text: I am the Director and CEO of Słoma Food Company, you should be familiar with my voice. Mr. Malkiewicz, you are now officially dismissed.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Bold Female Voice
steps.text: From now on, you no longer belong to the Słoma Food Company, nor the Mieszko Group——Please keep in mind at all times that you are representing the General Chamber of Commerce.

steps.name: Bold Female Voice
steps.text: When the Major ends, you may choose to stay or leave. You will be generously compensated based on your performance.

steps.name: Bold Female Voice
steps.text: Right now, there are three tasks waiting for you. You have no right to question them.

steps.name: Bold Female Voice
steps.text: Firstly, ensure the smooth continuation of the Major. This is of the utmost importance.

steps.name: Bold Female Voice
steps.text: Secondly, guide the public opinion regarding the Radiant Knight and related matters. We are not asking for 'damage control', what we want are 'benefits' on top of that.

steps.name: Bold Female Voice
steps.text: Thirdly, some contacts from the Armorless Union will be arriving at your location within three minutes. Supervise them as they carry out their duties. If there are any issues, report directly to the General Chamber of Commerce's Board of Directors.

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: Wait...! I don't want to be...!

steps.name: Bold Female Voice
steps.text: Is there anything you wish to say? Spokesman Malkiewicz?

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: I-I don't think...

steps.name: Corporate Employee
steps.text: No, I... I understand...

steps.name: Bold Female Voice
steps.text: Very good. I wish you the best of luck.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Haa... A dream... This is definitely a dream...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I heard the good news. Czarny's authority has been completely transferred to you, Spokesman... Malkiewicz, right?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: What do we do next? You might need a minute. I don't mind taking a break.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I-I don't understand. Why me...?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Wait, wait. Aren't you the same, Platinum? Why did you allow yourself to be pushed into this position? What should I do...?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Who knows? Maybe they just wanted to see someone become as nasty as they are.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Don't think too much when you're in Kazimierz.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: But... Just look at me... I can't even afford a decent suit. I...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Right, Mr. Czarny must have arranged some tasks for you. You should know what the Armorless Union is doing——

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: No idea.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I only know what I'm doing.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Th-then, what are you doing?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Oh... Usually people stop asking when I answer like that. You...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Never mind. I screwed something up a while ago and now I have to deal with it.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Five Knight-Assassins were made while hunting a target. Then they disappeared.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: The Armorless Union w-went missing?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: ...Are you really prepared to know the truth?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I... I have no other choice.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Really.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Pay close attention to the 'Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub' then. They're more than just competition knights. They openly... oppose the Armorless Union.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: ...The Radiant Knight has returned?

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: Word on the street is she descended from the skies and rescued Maria.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Rescued?

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: The Knights Association... No, it probably came from higher up. They arranged that match for Maria. The audience all believed that it was just a thrilling performance, but those with discerning eyes could tell...

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: They were going at it for real. If the Radiant Knight was any later, Maria would be dead.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: ...Are they giving up the game already?

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: Maybe we gave them more credit than they deserved. These things happen in every season of the Major——They don't care.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: What they care about doesn't matter. I never expected them to understand, but to think they don't even want to keep up appearances...

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: What's important is that in Kazimierz, no one cares.

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: They're telling people we're out of competition for a while because of a training accident...

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: ...That's ugly.

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: 'That's ugly.'

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: ...Pfft. Hahahaha. Hey, what the hell's up with that? Isn't that totally good for us?

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: If they had gone through the National Council instead of scurrying around in the dark, we'd really be in trouble.

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: You... You let yourself go after just relaxing for a bit.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Mhmm... Our opponents couldn't wait any longer and acted first, but ended up giving us the win instead. How could I not be happy?

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: When those two finish their jobs, we'll finally get to the main point.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: What? Didn't you get your fill in the arena?

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: Tch...... The more I cross weapons with that trash, the more I hate those knight nobles. What disgusts me the most is that I used to be one of them.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: *Sigh* So complicated.

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: They don't have a penny's worth of dignity or faith. The knight nobles are total sellouts now.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Don't get yourself worked up. This topic always does that to you. Don't worry, they'll get what's coming to them.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: Though, before that, we should straighten out the enemy right in front of us.

steps.name: Ashlock Knight
steps.text: ——The Armorless Union.

steps.name: Flametail Knight
steps.text: We'll expose them out in the open for all to see, yeah?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Hey Margaret, how long has it been since you've been home?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Your room is still as it used to be! I clean it all the time... Oh, I think we sold the furniture though...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: B-but, it's fine! At least——

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Maria, just seeing you all makes me feel like I've returned home.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...Margaret.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Maria, your equipment...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh! I went and borrowed your old stuff... Hehe, how is it? Fits me nicely, right?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Yeah, it's a nice fit. You've really grown up.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Hehe... I'm as tall as you now.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You've worked hard, truly. I wasn't able to talk with you properly in the arena earlier...... I've really missed you, Maria.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ehh... Sis, you're making me embarrassed...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You've fought alone until now, but you survived, you've persisted.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I was aware what kind of impact my decision back then would have on Uncle and you, but I never thought that you would——

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: There's something you absolutely have to do, that you'd never back down from, right?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...Yeah.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Then you didn't do anything wrong!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Besides... I was never able to become like you, tough inside and out...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But I've started to understand. At least, I can think about what Aunt Zofia has always said... I can think about what a knight truly is.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Even though I still couldn't become like you... I've been able to get where I am today, with everyone's help!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: If there were ever any beliefs that I held on to, they came from you! Because I too am a member of the Nearl family!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: B-But, Margaret, you can't ever leave again, not like how you left six years ago...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I'll follow you this time, no matter what happens to us in the end... I, I believe in you.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Maria, you... Heh, you've really grown up.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...E-Ehh? Where did all of that come from...?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Anyway, just go upstairs and have a look——

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...Margaret.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Uncle... this is...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Keep quiet.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Margaret. What did you come back for?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Don't you know what it means for you to appear here?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You rescued Maria... But why did you return to Kazimierz?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Do you know how much your father and grandfather sacrificed to 'send you out'?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Yet you dare to appear here so brazenly... Do you think that the Association and the corporations aren't watching your every step?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...I will join the Major.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Impossible.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I will retake the glory that belongs to the knights.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Glory is meaningless.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Meaning is in the eye of the beholder.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Kazimierz has changed. They have changed.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: —Yet I'm still here. We're all still here.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Don't be greedy... Margaret.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I imagined you would calm down after leaving Kazimierz... But this is your answer?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You're wasting my time.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Uncle...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Enough.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: In the time I've spent talking to you, a mountain of documents has piled up waiting for me to handle. Don't interrupt my work...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Leave Kazimierz before things turn worse. You've made a life for yourself elsewhere, just don't come back anymore.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Uncle! How can you say that?!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Maria.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Uncle Młynar, I understand your decision. I still respect you just as I did back then.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I also hope for your support.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: —Understand?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You know nothing of what I've seen, what I've done. Yet you still hold on to your idealistic thoughts...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I was once lucky enough to catch a glimpse of hope. I have also experienced the shadow of war.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I'm merely choosing to continue believing in my faith, and to fight for it.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...Kazimierz will not change one bit, no matter how much the Radiant Knight sacrifices, no matter how much she wins.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Of course. Of that, I'm very clear.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Even so...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Even so.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: ...Draw your blade, Margaret.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: U-Uncle?!

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: If you insist on being so stubborn, I have no choice but to to teach you how to 'give up' the hard way. To fall by my blade is far better than falling into the shadow of the Armorless Union.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...As you wish.

steps.name: Senomy
steps.text: Those stupid competition knights are just a bunch of trash willing to be manipulated for the sake of money.

steps.name: Senomy
steps.text: If the young mistress of the Nearl family were to have an accident as well, don't even bother calling this campaign knight a knight anymore! I'll go flip the National Council's goddamned table myself!

steps.name: Senomy
steps.text: ——That's what the old man said.
...Senomy, there's no need to mimic him so convincingly...

steps.name: Senomy
steps.text: Ehh, but he specifically instructed me to convey the exact message.
You don't need to listen to everything he says.

steps.name: Senomy
steps.text: He even said that if the Grand Knight didn't agree, he'd go greet the Radiant Knight himself, even if he had to hobble all the way there.

steps.name: Senomy
steps.text: He also said that if you sighed and cupped your forehead, reluctant to answer, he would——
Alright, alright... I know how unhappy he is. He hasn't changed at all, still causing a ruckus in the Court Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz every day over what few accomplishments he has...
Don't forget he is still an offender.

steps.name: Senomy
steps.text: But the National Council, totally corrupted by the General Chamber of Commerce, has no right to convict my old man. They don't representing the citizens or the law at all. They're just representing themselves and the merchants behind them.
...He taught you that as well?

steps.name: Senomy
steps.text: No, I figured that one out myself.
*Sigh*...
Is that all?

steps.name: Senomy
steps.text: Ah, there's one more thing.
...Yeah.

steps.name: Senomy
steps.text: The people from Rhodes Island seem to have arrived.
